newsitem.title: USA: CalEnergy begins offer for NYSEG.
newsitem.headline: CalEnergy begins offer for NYSEG.

text.p: CalEnergy Co Inc said Friday it has formally commenced a cash tender offer of $24.50 per shaer for 6,540,670 New York State Electric & Gas Corp shares.
Holders tendering their shares will be entitled to retain the $0.35/share dividend payable in August, CalEnergy noted.

It said the offer is to acquire shares, which together with stock held by CalEnergy, would represent 9.9 percent of NYSEG's outstanding common, noting this is the maximum percentage that could be acquired without certain federal and state regulatory approvals.
CalEnergy said the offer is its first step toward the intended acquisition of 100 percent of NYSEG's common.
The offer is scheduled to expire at 2400 EDT August 14/0400 GMT August 15.
The company also said it continues to hope to meet with NYSEG management "to discuss our $27.50 per share cash merger proposal."

CalEnergy said the offer is not subject to any financing conditions. It is, however, conditioned on, among other things, at least 6,540,670 shares being tendered and not withdrawn, and the expiration or termination of waiting periods imposed by the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act.
Lehman Brothers Inc and Credit Suisse First Boston Corp are acting as financial advisors to CalEnergy and as dealer managers in connection with the offer, it said.
